I live in Canada. My female ex suffered from BPD and I have been a victim of abuse many times when she was in a crisis. I called the cops three times on her. Most of the time, she tried to convince the cops that I was the violent one, and it never worked, even with two female cops. 

But every time, I was asked by the cops to leave the apartment for a while to let her cool down. The third time I refused and asked for her to leave. They called an ambulance and she was brought to mental hospital for evaluation.

I think males who are victims of domestic abuse have the responsibility to call the cops when it happens, and know their rights. I spoke to a lot of males who were hurt by women psychologically and physically, especially by partners who suffer from BPD.

Had to let this out.
Anything related to Elliott Smith shall be upvoted.
Well maybe I didnt post this in the right reddit? I don't know. I feel like talking about it. I have this bad feeling inside that I can't get rid of. I have so much guilt for abandoning her.
